title: Tarsikh al-ʿAqeedah: min al-Maʿrifah ilá al-Muraqabah
description: A path that roots the ʿaqeedah (creed) of your child (10–12) before bulūgh (puberty): from knowledge to muraqabah (watchfulness) and conviction—Islamic identity, deep understanding of the arkān al-īmān (pillars of faith), ikhlāṣ (sincerity) and muraqabah, and riḍā bi-l-qadr (contentment with divine decree).

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.arabic: ترسيخ العقيدة: من المعرفة إلى المراقبة
review_defects.english: Tarsikh al-ʿAqeedah: min al-Maʿrifah ilá al-Muraqabah
review_defects.why: The English title is a full transliteration of the Arabic, not a translation. It fails to convey the meaning ('Establishing the Creed: From Knowledge to Watchfulness') to an English reader, while the description is translated. This makes the title inaccessible and does not communicate the intended message.
